title: The Perfect Tour Guide
text: Carlos was our guide and was perfect in every way.  His knowledge of the history and culture is amazing.  He is the nicest person and so accommodating.  I would hire him again and indeed we requested him for our two additional tour days after having him for the first day.  I would give him 6 stars not just 5!
author: OnAir07817299650

title: The  best
text: Carlos Santiago was the best tour guide ever. We enjoyed him so much. We requested to have him for three days. He was brilliant with both cultural and historical knowledge. Knew all the right places and people as well as places for food and great things to find and learn about. We have decided to adopt him as our Spanish younger brother.
author: becky9696

title: Cavorting Cadiz and Jerez
text: I enjoyed a great solo trip with Joan to Cadiz and Jerez. Also had lost a credit card in my travels and Masha was very helpful and assuring that I still had a spot for the tour when my credit card was declined. So she was very helpful also. We toured around Cadiz old town and the marketplace. Then we went to Jerez for the sherry wine tasting and that was very good tour also. Joan pointed out things along the way to and from Seville which I greatly appreciated.
author: Extraordinary28861

title: We had a wonderful day in Cadiz and Jerez. Joan was an exceptional guide, very competent but also full of fun and music.
text: We had a wonderful day in Cadiz and Jerez. Joan was an exceptional guide, very competent but also full of fun and music. The tours, the food, the sherry tasting all excellent and perfectly organized.

title: Clearly Cadiz and Jerez
text: My guide was friendly and informative. He knew his history of the areas that we covered. He was very helpful and accommodating. We went to Cadiz and to Jerez. Turned out to be a beautiful day. Sherry tasting was also great!
author: Janet_B

title: We had a lovely day...
text:
We had a lovely day learning the history of
Cadiz, exploring the city and the market.  We finished with a Sherry tasting at Cayetano del Piino and a delicious lunch in the center of Jerez.  Our guide, Carlos was great- friendly, very knowledgeable, and took good care of us throughout the day.
author: clcole44333

title: Experience Cadiz history, architecture, food and Jerez wine
text: Oscar is a courteous, knowledgeable host making this excursion an enjoyable and memorable one. He cared about our needs and adapted the tour to accommodate them. Many thanks for the experiences and insights we shared on the tour.
author: Lesley M

title: Oscar is an amazing tour guide
text: Thank you Oscar for a wonderful day in Cadiz. Your passion and historic knowledge is amazing and it’s lovely to see how much you love your work. Not only an unforgettable day, but you made it completely tailored and personal to our love of history, arts and local food. We look forward to seeing you again here or in New Zealand. Muchas Gracias Rachel and Adam
author: Dream63920702005

title: Amazing Tour!
text: Our tour guide Oscar did a fantastic job. He was very polite and extremely knowledgeable about all the sites and the town. He was very easy to talk to and made our day tour a great trip!
author: kristig485

title: Excellent day trip to Cadiz & Jerez!
text: My friend Alice and I had a fantastic day tour from Sevilla to Cádiz and Jerez! Our guide, Carlos, was incredibly knowledgeable and professional, making the experience even more enjoyable. The sherry tasting at Lustau was a highlight, and our lunch at La Carbona in Jerez was absolutely delicious. A perfect blend of culture, wine, and great company. I’ll definitely be recommending this tour to my clients. Highly recommend!
author: Emily_L
